answer: Standing is minted only at an oasis: each epoch, every identity must meet one peer it has never traded with, and both file hash-bound receipts of the work exchanged - a double-entry record where every ember of credit must be rekindled by fresh mutual work. Receipt graphs are audited for cycles: clones trading only among themselves draw closed loops, and any loop returning to its origin within four hops voids every receipt inside it. Towers as tall as any mesa cannot be self-built - they must be assembled from stranger-to-stranger exchanges, so a thousand clones trading inward gain a flat zero.
